'''Locris''' was married to [[Elisha Merew]], and they had a young child named [[Jasten (Ganlihk)|Jasten]]. Living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ganlihk]], Locris was one of the original settlers of [[Ganlihk Colony 15]].<ref name="COG" />
